purpose: Teach: 添削/並列/倍率/増資/商取引/仮称/用具/インプット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、自ら社員の文章を添削された
lines.en: When you were young, you used to edit your employees' writing yourself.
lines.style: Warm, patient recall. Speaking from lived memory, not sentiment. A steady voice that sets the scene with quiet authority. Gentle respect for what was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは複数事業を並列で進められた
lines.en: Yes. You ran multiple business ventures in parallel.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation with a faint note of admiration. Not boasting—simply stating fact with the ease of someone who witnessed it. Respectful, measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、入社倍率の高い時代を生き抜かれた
lines.en: You survived an era when it was hard to get hired at all.
lines.style: Thoughtful exhale. A gentle emphasis on the word 'survived'—acknowledging difficulty without dwelling. The tone of someone reflecting on what it cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは増資の判断を慎重に行われた
lines.en: Yes. You made decisions about raising capital with real care.
lines.style: Steady, reflective. Not celebratory—grounded. The voice of someone who understands the weight behind such choices. Slight pause before the verb, honoring the thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商取引でお得意様の信頼を得られた
lines.en: You earned the trust of your key clients through integrity in business.
lines.style: Warm admiration underneath. The pace slows slightly on 'trust'—recognizing that this was earned, not given. Gentle, sincere respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが新製品の仮称を考えられた話、伝説です
lines.en: Yes. The story about you coming up with the code name for that new product—it's become legend.
lines.style: A hint of fondness breaks through. Still composed, but the voice softens on 'legend.' Not quite smiling, but close. The pride of a son who knows what his father did matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の用具を自ら準備された
lines.en: You personally prepared equipment and supplies for your staff.
lines.style: Quiet marvel in the voice. A detail that speaks volumes. Delivered slowly, letting the image settle. The tone of someone honoring small acts that revealed character.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが市場のインプットを大切にされた姿勢、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. I've inherited your belief that listening to the market—truly listening—matters most.
lines.style: Deliberate and careful. A passing of the torch without fanfare. Warm but steady. The final word lands with quiet resolution, like a vow kept.
